entries.title: Job 9:1
segments: ¶And Job made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 9:2
segments: Truly, I see that it is so: and how is it possible for a man to get his right before God?

entries.title: Job 9:3
segments: If a man was desiring to go to law with him, he would not be able to give him an answer to one out of a thousand questions.

entries.title: Job 9:4
segments: He is wise in heart and great in strength: who ever made his face hard against him, and any good came of it?

entries.title: Job 9:5
segments: It is he who takes away the mountains without their knowledge, overturning them in his wrath:

entries.title: Job 9:6
segments: Who is moving the earth out of its place, so that its pillars are shaking:

entries.title: Job 9:7
segments: Who gives orders to the sun, and it does not give its light; and who keeps the stars from shining.

entries.title: Job 9:8
segments: By whose hand the heavens were stretched out, and who is walking on the waves of the sea:

entries.title: Job 9:9
segments: Who made the Bear and Orion, and the Pleiades, and the store-houses of the south:

entries.title: Job 9:10
segments: Who does great things not to be searched out; yes, wonders without number.

entries.title: Job 9:11
segments: See, he goes past me and I see him not: he goes on before, but I have no knowledge of him.

entries.title: Job 9:12
segments: If he puts out his hand to take, by whom may it be turned back? who may say to him, What are you doing?

entries.title: Job 9:13
segments: God's wrath may not be turned back; the helpers of Rahab were bent down under him.

entries.title: Job 9:14
segments: ¶How much less may I give an answer to him, using the right words in argument with him?

entries.title: Job 9:15
segments: Even if my cause was good, I would not be able to give an answer; I would make request for grace from him who was against me.

entries.title: Job 9:16
segments: If I had sent for him to be present, and he had come, I would have no faith that he would give ear to my voice.

entries.title: Job 9:17
segments: For I would be crushed by his storm, my wounds would be increased without cause.

entries.title: Job 9:18
segments: He would not let me take my breath, but I would be full of bitter grief.

entries.title: Job 9:19
segments: If it is a question of strength, he says, Here I am! and if it is a question of a cause at law, he says, Who will give me a fixed day?

entries.title: Job 9:20
segments: Though I was in the right, he would say that I was in the wrong; I have done no evil; but he says that I am a sinner.

entries.title: Job 9:21
segments: I have done no wrong; I give no thought to what becomes of me; I have no desire for life.

entries.title: Job 9:22
segments: ¶It is all the same to me; so I say, He puts an end to the sinner and to him who has done no wrong together.

entries.title: Job 9:23
segments: If death comes suddenly through disease, he makes sport of the fate of those who have done no wrong.

entries.title: Job 9:24
segments: The land is given into the power of the evil-doer; the faces of its judges are covered; if not by him, then who has done it?

entries.title: Job 9:25
segments: ¶My days go quicker than a post-runner: they go in flight, they see no good.

entries.title: Job 9:26
segments: They go rushing on like reed-boats, like an eagle dropping suddenly on its food.

entries.title: Job 9:27
segments: If I say, I will put my grief out of mind, I will let my face be sad no longer and I will be bright;

entries.title: Job 9:28
segments: I go in fear of all my pains; I am certain that I will not be free from sin in your eyes.

entries.title: Job 9:29
segments: You will not let me be clear of sin! why then do I take trouble for nothing?

entries.title: Job 9:30
segments: If I am washed with snow water, and make my hands clean with soap;

entries.title: Job 9:31
segments: Then you will have me pushed into the dust, so that I will seem disgusting to my very clothing.

entries.title: Job 9:32
segments: For he is not a man as I am, that I might give him an answer, that we might come together before a judge.

entries.title: Job 9:33
segments: There is no one to give a decision between us, who might have control over us.

entries.title: Job 9:34
segments: Let him take away his rod from me and not send his fear on me:

entries.title: Job 9:35
segments: Then I would say what is in my mind without fear of him; for there is no cause of fear in myself.
